pages.title: Hunger no longer rules
pages.text: “Even after death, I still feel hunger. Strange how tightly the habits of a living body cling to me.”$(br2)The Necklace of the Beyond is a relic of the $(l:beginning/paths)$(#B03030)Path of Hunger$()$(/l). While worn as a chestplate or placed in a cell of the $(l:beginning/vault)Vault$(/l), it removes hunger costs for abilities, $(l:beginning/spirit_instinct)Ghost Instincts$(/l), and movement in $(l:beginning/spirit_form)Spirit Form$(/l).

pages.title: An invisible ornament
pages.text: You can hide the necklace with the eye icon next to its Vault cell without losing its properties. It removes only the listed hunger costs and grants no other bonuses.
